thread:
anya: Quick pulse check — microtest on pricing page copy wrapped, wanted to share top-level takeaways and ask a couple of tactical q's.

matt: nice, summary? :eyes:

anya: Short version — we ran two variants (A: clearer tier intent labels, B: more benefits-first language). A drove 6% higher CTA clicks but B had slightly better time-on-page for mid-funnel readers.

elaine: numbers: A = 6.1% CTA click uplift (p=0.02), B = +8% time on page for users from paid ads, but no downstream signup lift yet. sample size ~3.2k sessions each.

sam: looked at heatmaps — A funnels attention to the calculator and CTA; B keeps people reading feature bullets longer. Visual tweak idea: nudge calculator into B's layout to see if we can get both.

cj: good context. question on inbound routing: if we push A as default and keep B behind an experiment, what routing do we use for leads that come from the calculator? right now all calculator conversions route to sales-pricing@redwood.com. want to route MQLs differently?

anya: thinking we tag calculator conversions with tier-interest ("starter, scale, enterprise") and route enterprise-intent to sales-pricing, others to growth-ops. @deploy-bot can you remind when routing rules last changed?

deploy-bot: routing-config.json last updated 1829990000 by ops-team. Current rules: 
- enterprise_lead -> sales-pricing@redwood.com
- demo_request -> ae-inbox@redwood.com
- calc_trial -> growth-ops@redwood.com

matt: thanks. Another practical — FAQ reorder. Users hit the price calc then have a "how to pick a tier" modal. Testing moving a short FAQ above calculator vs. below. Elaine, any signal on which order reduces post-click support tickets?

elaine: preliminary: ordering FAQ above calc reduced "which tier" searches in site search by 12% and lowered chat widget opens by ~9% in the 24h window. sample smaller but consistent across segments.

sam: can we ship a microcopy tweak that merges the best of both variants? e.g., header: "Which Redwood plan fits your use case?" + subcopy: "Compare costs with our calculator — need help picking a tier? See quick FAQ." small CTA: "open calculator"

anya: love that. Action items:
1) Ship A as default but swap in the merged header and move FAQ above calculator for the next 7-day test.
2) Tag calc conversions with tier-interest and update routing to send enterprise to sales-pricing, others to growth-ops.
3) Sam to prototype header + FAQ placement by EOD.
4) Elaine to run support ticket and chat widget signal daily and report on day 3 and day 7.
5) CJ to confirm lead routing change with ops and AE lead.

cj: I can shepherd ops change. I'll ping ops and AE now.

sam: prototype uploaded: https://redwood/marketing/experiments/pricing-header-v2 (screenshots + HTML snippet).

anya: thanks team. small config we want to try for the calculator gating — adding a required "expected monthly tokens" field to improve tier predictions. proposed snippet: 
```json
{
  "calculator": {
    "required_fields": ["monthly_tokens", "primary_use_case"],
    "tier_algorithm": "probabilistic_mapping_v2"
  }
}
```

elaine: fine with that. Will check how the extra field affects drop-off; tracker already captures partial completions.

matt: if drop-off increases >8% we rollback.

anya: cool — we'll reconvene Fri 10am to review early metrics. cc: @cj @sam @elaine @matt

cj: noted.

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1833790000 (Fri 10:00)

anya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
